_comment: SMTP Webhook Forwarder - Complete Configuration Example
_comment_description: This file demonstrates all available configuration options with detailed explanations

server._comment_port: SMTP listening port. Standard ports: 25 (SMTP), 587 (submission), 2525 (testing). Can be overridden with SMTP_PORT env var
server._comment_hostname: Server hostname used in SMTP greeting. Required field. Can be overridden with SMTP_HOSTNAME env var
server._comment_security_mode: Encryption mode: 'tls' (implicit TLS), 'ssl' (same as tls), 'starttls' (opportunistic TLS), 'none' (plaintext). Can be overridden with SMTP_SECURITY_MODE env var
server._comment_tls_cert_path: Path to TLS certificate file. Required when security_mode is not 'none'. Can be overridden with TLS_CERT_PATH env var
server._comment_tls_key_path: Path to TLS private key file. Required when security_mode is not 'none'. Can be overridden with TLS_KEY_PATH env var
server._comment_max_email_size: Maximum email size in bytes (10MB = 10485760). Emails exceeding this will be rejected with SMTP 552. Can be overridden with MAX_EMAIL_SIZE env var
server._comment_max_concurrent_connections: Maximum number of concurrent SMTP connections. Helps prevent resource exhaustion
server._comment_read_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for client to send email data. Prevents slow client attacks
server._comment_write_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait when sending SMTP responses to client

auth._comment_enabled: Whether to require SMTP authentication. When true, clients must provide valid credentials

credentials._comment: First user account - supports PLAIN and LOGIN auth mechanisms
Second user account - multiple accounts can be configured

auth._comment_credentials: List of valid username/password pairs. Required when auth is enabled. Passwords are case-sensitive

routes._comment: Exact email address match - highest priority

webhook._comment: Webhook with HMAC-SHA256 signature for security

routes._comment: Another exact match with different webhook
Wildcard domain match - catches all emails at example.com

webhook._comment: No secret configured - webhook will be sent without signature
Longer timeout for slower webhook endpoints

routes._comment: Accumulative matching: support@example.com will match BOTH the exact rule above AND this wildcard rule

webhook._comment: This webhook will also receive emails to support@example.com for redundancy

_comment_routes: Routing rules match recipient addresses. Exact matches: 'user@domain.com'. Wildcard matches: '*@domain.com'. Multiple matches send to all matching webhooks (accumulative)

defaults._comment: Default webhook for emails that don't match any routing rule

webhook._comment: If no default is configured, unmatched emails will be rejected with SMTP 550
